name: research-plugins
description: Plugins for academic writing rules and PDF literature search. Claude Code and Codex use the same skills.

plugins.name: research-writing
plugins.description: Shared working rules for academic paper writing. Covers style and expressions to avoid, hedging by evidence grade, confirming citations, the protocol for proposing revisions and for the user's confirmation, tracking open items and figure rules. Also includes an entry skill that starts manuscript work from any folder, and an initialiser that creates a new manuscript project with its tools, settings and tracker files in one go.

plugins.name: paper-index
plugins.description: Indexes a PDF literature library down to the full text and searches it. Scopus searches fetch abstracts too (COMPLETE view) and are matched against the papers you hold; open-access papers you lack are downloaded to a staging folder and turned into full text (--fetch-oa). Files are matched again by content when their names change. The API key is read only from an environment variable.
